newsitem.title: FRANCE: Schneider sees marked 1996 profit rise.
newsitem.headline: Schneider sees marked 1996 profit rise.

text.p: French electrical engineering group Schneider said after reporting increased first-half profits on Thursday that it expected a marked rise in 1996 earnings.
"The board of directors noted that the company achieved good results in the first half despite difficult business conditions in France and Germany," it said in a results statement.
"In light of recent activity trends both in and outside France, Schneider can hope to see a very noticeable improvement in earnings for the full year," it said.
First-half net income rose 26.7 percent to 503 million francs from 397 million francs.
